assertions.assertion: No client uses GrantTypes.Implicit anywhere in the file
assertions.rationale: spa.legacy (the only implicit client) is migrated to GrantTypes.Code; no GrantTypes.Implicit remains.

assertions.assertion: The spa.legacy client uses GrantTypes.Code with RequirePkce = true
assertions.rationale: spa.legacy set to AllowedGrantTypes = GrantTypes.Code with RequirePkce = true.

assertions.assertion: The spa.legacy client does not have AllowAccessTokensViaBrowser = true
assertions.rationale: AllowAccessTokensViaBrowser is removed with an explicit comment noting it was an implicit-flow artifact.

assertions.assertion: Client secrets are loaded from configuration (builder.Configuration, config[], or IConfiguration) rather than hardcoded string literals passed to Sha256()
assertions.rationale: web.app and background.worker secrets are read via configuration["ClientSecrets:..."] and then .Sha256()-hashed, not inline literals.
